title: About Dream To Build
subtitle: Dragging High Concept Pretty Pictures Kicking and Screaming into the Real World
summary: Dream To Build is a dedicated digital archive and technical workshop workspace documenting real-world engineering, custom fabrication, and conceptual blueprints behind pre-1975 custom restomods, hybrid powertrains, and space-frame designs.

specifications.focus: Pre-1975 Restomods, Hybrid Powertrains & Space-Frame Engineering
specifications.pillars: Active Shop Builds | Design & Blueprints | Pure Vision Concepts
specifications.curator: Scot Stockton / Dream To Build Studio

narrative: Dream To Build serves as a central hub bridging the gap between unconstrained technical styling explorations and hands-on metal fabrication.
1. Active Shop Builds: Hands-on metal fabrication, chassis engineering, custom wiring, and precision powertrain assembly.
2. Design & Blueprints: Calculated geometry, CAD layouts, suspension kinematics, and structural mockups.
3. Pure Vision Concepts: High-concept automotive styling and unconstrained technical explorations.
DEVELOPMENT & COLLABORATION NOTICE: These galleries and technical specification sheets are undergoing continuous updates with extensive assistance from AI tools.

Because this is an active, real-time creative workspace, technical discrepancies and errors may be rampant—however, identifying and refining these AI-generated hallucinations is an intentional and vital part of our review, verification, and design update process.
